nodes.title: Describe the setting
widgets_values: Describe only the background and setting behind the subject, its materials and the lighting, in 30 to 60 words. Do not describe any person, face, hair, clothing or pose, and do not describe the framing, cropping or shot type (no close-up, portrait or headshot): the picture is only part of a larger scene that continues past its edges. Use plain factual language. Do not invent actions, camera motion, sound or objects. Output only the description.

nodes.title: Show Text - Prompt sent to Klein
Note
widgets_values: Qwen3-VL 8B describes the setting behind your subject, not the person. Describing the person made Klein paint a second face under tight crops.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values: Your line from What goes there comes first, then the description. Show Text shows the prompt Klein gets.

nodes.title: Stitch Inpaint - Put the new part back
Note
widgets_values: The canvas becomes the starting latent. Its mask marks the gray areas, so the sampler paints only there.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values: Klein reads the prompt with the canvas as a reference. At CFG 1 the negative side is not used.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values: 4 steps, CFG 1, euler and simple: the settings for the distilled Klein 9B.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values: Your image goes back on top. Tone match shifts the new area's brightness and color to sit with your image along the seam.
